title: Large Language Model Unlearning Under the Microscope: A Benchmark Study
abstract: arXiv:2510.07626v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs), known as LLM unlearning, aims to remove undesired data, knowledge, and behaviors while preserving model capabilities. Despite rapid progress over the past two years, research in LLM unlearning remains fragmented, with limited clarity on what constitutes effective unlearning and how it should be rigorously evaluated. In this work, we present a principled taxonomy of twelve recent stateful unlearning methods, grouped into three methodological families: divergence-driven optimization, representation misalignment, and rejection-based targeted unlearning. Building on this taxonomy, we revisit the evaluation of unlearning effectiveness (UE), utility retention (UT), and robustness (Rob), focusing on WMDP for hazardous knowledge and associated model capability removal. translated_title: 大语言模型遗忘的显微镜式审视：一项基准研究
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘技术在大语言模型中的应用，即所谓的大语言模型遗忘，旨在移除不期望的数据、知识和行为，同时保留模型的各项能力。尽管过去两年间该领域取得了快速进展，但大语言模型遗忘的研究仍然较为零散，对于什么构成有效的遗忘以及如何对其进行严格评估仍缺乏清晰的认识。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个系统性的分类体系，将十二种最新的有状态遗忘方法归纳为三大方法学家族：散度驱动优化、表示对齐失调以及基于拒绝的定向遗忘。基于这一分类体系，我们重新审视了遗忘有效性、效用保留和鲁棒性三个方面的评估，重点关注WMDP基准中有害知识及相关模型能力的移除。我们的分析表明，当前以多项选择题准确率为主导的评估方式仅能提供一种叙述性的（评估视角）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将十二种大语言模型遗忘方法归纳为三大方法家族的系统性分类体系，并重新审视了遗忘有效性、效用保留和鲁棒性的评估方法，揭示了当前以多项选择题准确率为主导的评估方式的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a principled taxonomy of twelve stateful LLM unlearning methods grouped into three methodological families, and systematically revisits the evaluation of unlearning effectiveness, utility retention, and robustness, revealing the limitations of current MCQ-accuracy-dominated evaluations.
